    Methods

    Name Description
    CountUntilLineSeparator(int, out bool)

    Counts the amount of items until the next line separator in the buffer, relative to a given index. Only line separators count - regular whitespace do not. CRLF counts as a single line separator, to avoid double counting.
    CountUntilNotWhitespace(int)

    Counts the amount of items until the next non-whitespace item in the buffer, relative to a given index. Line separators are included in the whitespace category.
    CountUntilWhitespace(int)

    Counts the amount of items until the next whitespace item in the buffer, relative to a given index. Line separators are included in the whitespace category.
    CountWhile(Func<int, TItem, bool>, int)

    Counts the amount of items, starting from a given index, while a predicate returns true.
    GetLengthOfLine(int)

    Returns the length of a line given its 0-based line number. Line separators do not count towards the length.
    GetLengthOfLineFromIndex(int)

    Returns the length of a line given a 0-based index of one of its items. Line separators do not count towards the length.
    GetLine(int)

    Given a 0-based line number, returns the matching line as an array of buffer items.
    GetLineFromIndex(int)

    Tries to read the line that contains the item at index. No end of line characters are added.
    GetLineNumberFromIndex(int)

    Determines the 0-based line number of the line that contains the item located at index.
    GetSourceLocation(int)

    Converts an index into a location.
    GetWord(int, out bool)

    Tries to read the word at index index, which can be a span of whitespace (if the starting index points to whitespace) or a span of non-whitespace content (if the starting index does not point to whitespace).
    GetWord(int, Func<int, TItem, bool>, out bool)

    Tries to read the word at index index, which can be a span of items verified by itemKindPredicate (if the starting index is verified by itemKindPredicate) or a span of content not verified by itemKindPredicate (if the starting index does not point to anything verified by itemKindPredicate).
    GetWord(int, TItem, out bool)

    Tries to read the word at index index, which can be a span of itemKind (if the starting index points to itemKind) or a span of non-itemKind content (if the starting index does not point to itemKind).

    Slices a region of the buffer.

    Slices a region of the buffer into a performant span.
    TryGetChar(int, out TItem)

    Tries to read the next item in the buffer, relative to an index.
    TryGetLine(int, Span<TItem>, out int)

    Given a 0-based line number, assigns the exact line to a result buffer (destination).

    Tries to read the word at index index, which can be a span of items verified by itemKindPredicate (if the starting index is verified by itemKindPredicate) or a span of content not verified by itemKindPredicate (if the starting index does not point to anything verified by itemKindPredicate).
    TryGetWord(int, Span<TItem>, out bool, out int)

    Tries to read the word at index index, which can be a span of whitespace (if the starting index points to whitespace) or a span of non-whitespace content (if the starting index does not point to whitespace).
